journey.name: Enabling Ark warns and hides Lightning-only settings
journey.description: Precondition: onboarded signet wallet with zero spending balance and no open channels, Ark disabled.

actions.action: Verify that the wallet home screen shows a Spending balance of 0
Verify that a "Lightning Connections" row is visible
Verify that a "Lightning Node" row is visible
Verify that a dialog titled "Experimental Feature" is shown and that it warns Ark funds are not backed up by the recovery phrase
Verify that the "Use Ark (experimental)" switch is on
Verify that the "Lightning Connections" row is not visible
Verify that the "Lightning Node" row is not visible
